source: Real Battlefield 6 Portal experiences, as sample content for local development, gathered on 2026-10-13. The listing, descriptions, dates and creator names come from EA's Battlefield 6 website. The progression mode, license requirements, player counts and map rotations come from looking each code up on gametools.network. The maps and tags these refer to are in reference.ts and portal-tags.json.

experiences.title: Jets & Helicopters | Practice vs Bots in Vehicles | Tsuru Reef
experiences.description:
Custom PVE Conquest mode:
- All aircraft available.
- Bots use all vehicles and play the objective.
- Dynamic bot count based on server load.
- Auto-resupply every 15s.
- In-game vehicle HP toggle (100% or 400%).
- In-game Nightfall mode toggle.

experiences.title: ! [VORTEX] 24/7 Hagental Breakthrough 64 | FULL XP | 60hz
experiences.description:
Skill-focused, 64-player infantry only Breakthrough on Hagental.
- Increased player movement speed to match BF4
- Bot backfill enabled
- 500 tickets and longer sector times
- No M320 explosive GL
